entries.name: GPUToolsCapture
entries.note: Metal GPU frame capture for the vendor's Xcode GPU debugger (gputrace boundaries and capture transitions in the binary). It is developer tooling of the vendor toolchain, not a daily-driver desktop feature.

entries.name: GPUToolsDeviceServices

entries.name: GPUToolsDiagnostics

entries.name: GPUToolsReplay
entries.note: Replays captured Metal frames for the vendor's Xcode GPU debugger; the replay service runs from GPUToolsDeviceServices. Developer tooling only, with no daily-driver role.

entries.name: GPUToolsTransport
entries.note: Transport between the vendor's Xcode GPU debugger and the device under capture (com.apple.gputools.transport). Developer tooling only, with no daily-driver role.

entries.name: GPUWrangler
entries.note: Apple GPU driver manager (version 8.1.12) for Apple silicon GPUs; BifrOSt drives GPUs through the kernel DRM driver.

entries.name: GRDBInternal

entries.name: GRDBv7Internal

entries.name: GRPCCoreInternal

entries.name: GRPCInProcessTransportInternal
entries.note: In-process transport of the vendor's private gRPC stack, used by its own service clients (cloud APIs). BifrOSt runs no such services, so the transport has no counterpart.

entries.name: GRPCProtobufInternal
entries.note: Protobuf message bindings of the vendor's private gRPC stack, used only by its own service clients (cloud APIs). BifrOSt has no such wire protocol.

entries.name: GRPCURLSessionTransportInternal
entries.note: URLSession transport for the vendor's private gRPC stack (com.apple.GRPCSwiftURLSessionTransportInternal), used by its own service clients. BifrOSt's HTTPS client in springboard/sdk/src/url.rs is the counterpart for ordinary web requests.

entries.name: GameCenterUICore

entries.name: GamePolicy
entries.note: Partial: the shell's Game Mode (springboard/src/shell/gamemode.rs) enters when a game is in front full screen (Games category or game = true), leaves after 3 s, and while on: CPU profile Performance, the game's nice and uclamp raised through bifrostd (priority socket), the background task scheduler paused, a menu bar item with Turn Off Game Mode, and a one-time notice. Full screen for app windows is the green button or ToShell::SetFullScreen. Not built: file indexing pause (no indexer runs in the shell), Bluetooth sniff interval (no mgmt connection update), and no framework API for apps to read the state.
entries.ready_note: Game Mode policy (entering when a game is in front, leaving on exit) is in shell::gamemode and tested.

entries.name: HumanUnderstandingEvidence
entries.note: Records on-device behaviour signals for the vendor's proactive assistant suggestions, with a deny list of apps; BifrOSt collects no such signals and has no assistant ecosystem to feed.

entries.name: HumanUnderstandingFoundation
entries.note: Shared base of the vendor's proactive assistant pipeline that infers user behaviour for suggestions; BifrOSt has no assistant ecosystem to feed.

entries.name: HybridDatabase
entries.note: Per-app searchable content index with a bounded on-disk store is in quicksearch.rs. Gap: no vector or hybrid index tables; the store holds keyword entries only.

entries.name: HybridDatabaseTokenizer
entries.note: Partial: bifrost_ui::search_rank has the search tokenizer (word segmentation close to UAX 29, case and diacritic folding, CJK pairs, prefix terms for as-you-type). The Search panel uses it to rank the Documents section. Not done: stemming, language rules beyond CJK pairs and folding, the spotlight index still matches with the older fuzzy matcher (springboard/src/shell/spotindex.rs), and other apps still split words inline (the Mail search).

entries.name: HybridQueryProcessing
entries.note: Mail search parses query words, quoted phrases and field limits such as from: and subject:, and requires every term to match. Gap: no query rewriting or semantic query planning, and the Search panel has no shared query parser.

entries.name: HybridSearch
entries.note: Keyword search over app content (quicksearch.rs) and over Mail messages (mail-desktop search.rs) works. Gap: the hybrid keyword plus semantic retrieval that the reference search engine runs is not built.

entries.name: HybridSearchAdapter
entries.note: Partial: each source of the Search panel is an adapter over its rows (springboard/src/shell/quicksearch.rs, build_tables and the Table source): apps, Settings pages, clock, Deildu titles, contacts, shortcuts, files and calendar events; indexed items reach the panel with their text, indexed time and open-count key. Not done: notes (no shell-side store), and per-app ranking inputs beyond text, time and opens.

entries.name: HybridSearchResultRanker
entries.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/search_rank.rs (Bm25, rank, order, Usage, Kind, SemanticHook)
entries.note: Partial: BM25 over weighted title and text fields with a coverage factor, plus title match, a kind prior for short queries (apps, settings, documents), recency of indexing, and local open counts on a log scale; the panel merges every source through it (springboard/ui/src/search_rank.rs, rank and Query::merge). The semantic term is a SemanticHook; the shell passes NoSemantic because no local text model is bundled.

entries.name: HybridSearchRuntime
entries.note: Partial: search_rank::Query runs each source on its own thread with a deadline, and the Search panel polls it every frame while a query is pending, so late sections stream in and the top hit and row order do not move once shown (springboard/src/shell/quicksearch.rs, start_run and groups_for). Not done: notes as a source, and a swappable on-device model behind the runtime.

entries.name: Hydra
entries.note: The reference preview and thumbnail extensions are covered by the in-app preview panel (peek.rs) and the shared thumbnail service (thumbnails.rs). Gap: no system-wide Quick Look extension point that third-party file types can register with.
entries.ready_note: Preview and thumbnail extensions are covered by the SDK peek and thumbnails modules, tested.

entries.name: IAP
entries.note: In-app purchase transactions and receipts are tied to the vendor's App Store account; the PC App Store has no in-app purchase API.

entries.name: IASUtilities
entries.note: Build a shell-level administrator sign-in sheet for system changes such as installs and updates. The privd PAM check (springboard/src/privd/auth.rs) guards login and account changes, not update or install prompts, and springboard/updated asks for no password; packaging/arch/runtime-packages.txt has no polkit or other authorization agent.

entries.name: IASUtilitiesCore
entries.note: Helper library under the reference installer-authorization agent; the reference bundle holds only a stream string table and a version plist, so its exact role is not determined.

entries.name: IDS
entries.note: Identity Services that register iMessage and FaceTime addresses with the vendor's servers; BifrOSt's Messages app speaks Matrix instead.

entries.name: IDSBlastDoorSupport
entries.note: Sandboxed parser for message payloads delivered by the vendor's identity service; BifrOSt receives no such payloads.

entries.name: IDSFoundation
entries.note: Shared plumbing for the vendor's identity service, which depends on the vendor's account servers.

entries.name: IDSHashPersistence
entries.note: Persists content hashes for the vendor's identity service sync, which runs against the vendor's servers.

entries.name: IDSKVStore
entries.note: Key-value account data for the vendor's identity service, kept in the vendor's cloud.

entries.name: IMAP
entries.note: The Mail app's IMAP wire parser and command builder (RFC 3501) are in imap.rs. Gap: literal responses are read by the connection layer, not by this module, and there is no system-wide IMAP account service for other apps.

entries.name: IMAVCore
entries.note: Audio and video call engine for the vendor's FaceTime and Messages calls, which run on the vendor's network.

entries.name: IMAssistantCore
entries.note: private framework, owner Intents; from SDK matrix siri-kit.json

entries.name: IMCore
entries.note: private framework, owner n/a: iMessage service

entries.name: IMCorePipeline
entries.note: private framework, owner n/a: iMessage service

entries.name: IMDMessageServices
entries.note: Message send and receive over the vendor's iMessage network; BifrOSt's Messages app is a Matrix client and has no such network.

entries.name: IMDPersistence
entries.note: Message database for the vendor's Messages history, synced through the vendor's iMessage service; BifrOSt keeps its chat history in the Matrix client's own store.

entries.name: IMDaemonCore
entries.note: Core daemon of the vendor's Messages service, which talks to the vendor's iMessage network; no BifrOSt daemon serves that network.

entries.name: IMFoundation
entries.note: Shared value types of the vendor's Messages stack for the iMessage network; they have no use outside that network.

entries.name: IMRCSTransfer
entries.note: Carrier RCS message transfer through the vendor's messaging service and the mobile carrier; a desktop has no carrier RCS link.

entries.name: IMSharedUI
entries.note: Shared interface pieces for the vendor's Messages app and its iMessage accounts; BifrOSt's Messages app is built on its own Matrix views.

entries.name: IMSharedUtilities
entries.note: Helpers shared by the vendor's Messages stack for the iMessage network; nothing in BifrOSt calls them.

entries.name: IMTranscoderAgent
entries.note: Background agent that converts Messages attachments for the vendor's iMessage delivery; the Matrix client sends its media without it.

entries.name: IMTranscoding
entries.note: Transcodes Messages media for the vendor's iMessage delivery formats; it has no job without that service.

entries.name: IMTransferAgent
entries.note: Background agent that moves Messages attachments through the vendor's iMessage service; it has no BifrOSt counterpart.

entries.name: IMTransferAgentClient
entries.note: Client API for the vendor's Messages attachment transfer agent, which serves only the iMessage service.

entries.name: IMTransferServices
entries.note: Upload and download services for Messages attachments on the vendor's iMessage service; the Matrix client uses its own media calls.

entries.name: IO80211
entries.note: netd runs Wi-Fi scans, association, DHCP and status to clients, and nl80211.rs reads and sets power save. Gap: no per-interface regulatory or roaming control, and the 802.11 driver itself is the Linux kernel's, not BifrOSt's.
entries.ready_note: netd and the Wi-Fi module run scans, association and DHCP status; the 802.11 driver is the Linux kernel's.

entries.name: IOAccelMemoryInfo
entries.note: The Graphics page shows video memory when the driver exposes it (AMD mem_info_vram_total in sysfs). Gap: no background collector that reports GPU memory per process, which the reference collector daemon does.

entries.name: IOAccelerator
entries.note: The kernel GPU driver and mesa give the shell GPU access through DRM and EGL (springboard/src/gpu/egl.rs). Gap: no app-facing accelerator interface exists, and the reference accelerator's per-device user client has no counterpart.
entries.ready_note: The kernel DRM driver and mesa give the shell GPU access through EGL; the EGL presenter path is tested.

entries.name: IOCEC
entries.note: Kernel side of the HDMI consumer-electronics control link, used to pair with the reference vendor's remote and TV control hardware (the reference image index lists a CEC interface listener plug-in beside it). BifrOSt runs no CEC path and a PC needs none of this hardware.

entries.name: IOFastPath
entries.note: Purpose not determined: the extracted reference bundle has only an Info.plist that names the bundle, and the framework binary is not in the extract, so no counterpart can be named.

entries.name: IOGPU
entries.note: GPU command submission on this system goes through the kernel DRM driver and mesa, reached by the shell's EGL presenter (springboard/src/gpu/egl.rs). Gap: no app-facing GPU device interface exists.
entries.ready_note: GPU command submission goes through the kernel DRM driver and mesa, reached by the shell's EGL presenter.

entries.name: IOImageLoader
entries.note: Purpose not determined: the extracted reference bundle has only an Info.plist that names the bundle, and the framework binary is not in the extract, so no counterpart can be named.

entries.name: IOKitten
entries.note: The reference bundle identifier marks this as the audio-class kernel driver family; the kernel ALSA drivers with alsa-utils and the shell's audio daemon (springboard/audiod) cover the same job. Gap: no app-facing audio device-driver interface exists.
entries.ready_note: The kernel ALSA drivers with alsa-utils and the shell's audio daemon (bifrost-audiod, enabled by the install hook) do the audio-driver job.

entries.name: IOMobileFramebuffer
entries.note: The display controller is driven by the kernel DRM/KMS driver, which the shell uses for modesetting and zero-copy scanout (kms.rs, scanout.rs). Gap: there is no display-controller interface for apps, and the handheld panel controls have no counterpart.
entries.ready_note: Display controller work is the kernel DRM/KMS driver driven by the shell's kms and scanout modules, tested.

entries.name: IOPlatformPluginFamily
entries.note: Power profiles come from power-profiles-daemon and the kernel cpufreq governors, and the shell requests CPU latency limits itself (pmqos.rs). Gap: the reference platform power plug-ins for battery and thermal policy have no counterpart.
entries.ready_note: Power profiles come from power-profiles-daemon (installed by runtime-packages) through the shell's pmqos module, tested.

entries.name: IOPresentment
entries.note: Apple display presentment for Apple hardware (Info.plist only); BifrOSt presents through the DRM/KMS driver.

entries.name: IOSurfaceAccelerator
entries.note: GPU-side copies and imports of shared buffers are done by mesa through the DRM driver (egl.rs, and dma-buf import in scanout.rs); the buffer model itself is in docs/parity-matrix/data/iosurface.json. Gap: no accelerated copy interface is offered to apps.
entries.ready_note: GPU-side buffer copies go through mesa and the EGL presenter, tested.

entries.name: IPConfiguration
entries.bifrost: springboard/src/net/wifi.rs (DHCP lease applied when the host runs no client); springboard/netd
entries.note: The network daemon and the Wi-Fi module configure addresses, routes and DHCP leases, and defer to the host's own DHCP client when one runs (wifi.rs). Gap: no per-interface IP configuration API is offered to apps, and the helper service has no equivalent.
entries.ready_note: NetworkManager, enabled by the installer, configures addresses, routes and DHCP leases; the Wi-Fi module defers to a host DHCP client.

entries.name: IPTelephony
entries.note: Cellular telephony stack; BifrOSt PC and Wi-Fi tablet have no cellular modem interface.

entries.name: ISPExclaveKitServices
entries.note: Apple camera image signal processor exclave services (Info.plist only); Apple hardware ISP.

entries.name: ISPServices
entries.note: Camera frames are captured from V4L2 nodes and converted to the shell's pixels (v4l2.rs). Gap: the image-signal-processing pipeline and its tuning are not exposed, and the camera driver does the processing.
entries.ready_note: Camera frames are captured from V4L2 nodes and converted to the shell's pixels; ISP tuning belongs to the camera driver.

entries.name: IconFoundation
entries.note: Layered icon model: an icon.json package (background solid or gradient, up to four PNG layers with position, scale, blend and opacity), the Default, Dark and Tinted variants with the style set from the shell, and one cached lookup (app_icon) from an app's icon path to its icon, used by the Dock and the home screen and launcher; Terminal, Camera and Magnifier ship as layered documents. Gap: the Settings row for Icon and widget style is not wired yet, SVG layers are not supported (the render crate has no SVG rasteriser), the Launchpad, app switcher and Files do not yet go through app_icon, and the thumbnail service has no icon lookup.
entries.ready_note: Layered icon documents and renderer are tested in the render crate.

entries.name: IconRendering
entries.note: Pure renderer: any pixel size and scale from one icon source, masked to the continuous-corner superellipse body (exponent 5) on an 80 percent canvas, with a specular edge and a drop shadow, premultiplied output, and a cache keyed by app, size, scale and variant. Gap: the file thumbnails do not use it yet, the body and shadow proportions are not checked against the reference grid, and layers must be PNG.
entries.ready_note: The icon renderer produces any size and scale from one source, with a cache keyed by app, size, scale and variant, and is tested.

entries.name: IconServices
entries.note: The thumbnail service returns an icon representation for a file, with the requests delivered in order (thumbnails.rs). Gap: app icons are not cached as a system service, and there is no icon store that other processes can query.
entries.ready_note: File icon representations come from the thumbnail service and providers, tested.

entries.name: IdleTimerServices
entries.note: Idle detection and auto-lock timing come from the shell's idle monitor, and sleep blockers are read through systemd-inhibit (sleep.rs). Gap: apps cannot hold an idle timer or inhibit sleep through an SDK call.
entries.ready_note: Idle detection, auto-lock timing and sleep blockers are tested in core and the sleep module.

entries.name: ImageCaptureDevices
entries.note: The device browser finds cameras and scanners and their hot-plug events, and the camera device model controls and downloads from them (camera_device.rs). Gap: the PTP and camera-specific driver modules are not covered beyond what the shell uses.
entries.ready_note: The device browser finds cameras and scanners with hot-plug events, and the camera model controls and downloads, with tests.

entries.name: ImageGenerationServices
entries.note: Brokers the reference vendor's on-device generative image models for its image-creation app, which needs a model bundle the vendor ships; BifrOSt runs no such model and has no image-generation service.

entries.name: ImageHarmonizationKit
entries.note: Ships the reference vendor's machine-learning models that blend a generated image into a photo, used by its image-creation app; BifrOSt bundles no such models and has no image-harmonisation service.

entries.name: ImagePlaygroundInternal
entries.note: private framework, owner ImagePlayground; from SDK matrix image-playground.json

entries.name: InAppFeedback
entries.note: Sends in-app feedback reports to the reference vendor's feedback service, which BifrOSt does not run; a PC user reports problems through the shell's own crash and log tools instead.

entries.name: InAppMessages
entries.note: Shows the reference vendor's promotional messages inside apps, fetched from its messaging service and rendered in a web view; BifrOSt has no such service and sends no marketing content to apps.

entries.name: InAppMessagesCore
entries.note: The shared model behind the in-app message view: campaign records and eligibility from the reference vendor's messaging service; BifrOSt has no such service, so nothing feeds this model.

entries.name: IncomingCallFilter
entries.note: The call directory model holds blocked numbers and caller labels, and the shell applies them to incoming calls (call_directory.rs). Gap: no call-filter extension point is offered to apps, and no telephony service feeds calls into it.
entries.ready_note: Call directory model (blocked numbers, labels) is tested and applied by the shell.

entries.name: InertiaCam
entries.note: Purpose not determined: the extracted bundle identifier names a camera group and the framework binary is not in the extract, so no counterpart can be named.

entries.name: InfoQueryPersonalizationFeatures
entries.note: Personalises the answers of the reference vendor's assistant and search from the user's personal data on its services; BifrOSt has no assistant backend and keeps no such personal index.

entries.name: InputAccessoriesSettings
entries.note: Purpose inferred only from the name, a settings module for input accessories; the reference index lists only its Info.plist, so the matching BifrOSt settings page is not confirmed.

entries.name: InputAnalytics
entries.note: Collects keyboard and text-input usage statistics for the reference vendor's analytics pipeline; BifrOSt sends no input telemetry and keeps no typing statistics.

entries.name: InputAnalyticsServer
entries.note: The server half of the input analytics pipeline, which receives the typing statistics and uploads them to the reference vendor; BifrOSt runs no such server and collects no input statistics.

entries.name: InputContext
entries.note: Each client input session has its own controller that routes keys and marked text to the input method (input_method.rs). Gap: the controller is not exposed as an SDK text-input context for apps outside the shell.
entries.ready_note: Per-client input controllers route keys and marked text, tested.

entries.name: InputTestFoundation
entries.note: The headless testing kit clicks, types into and queries a window by role and label without a shell or GPU (testing.rs). Gap: no hardware-level input injection is offered for tests that drive the real shell.

entries.name: InputToolKit
entries.note: Input methods register, keep composition state and switch input sources (input_method.rs, input_source.rs). Gap: no SDK API lets a third-party input method be written, and the per-language tool set is not shipped.
entries.ready_note: Input methods register, keep composition state and switch input sources, tested.

entries.name: InputToolKitUI
entries.note: The candidates window model holds the alternate text, paging and panel placement, and the shell paints it (candidates.rs). Gap: the input tool's own settings and picker panels are not built.
entries.ready_note: The candidates window model (paging, alternate text, panel placement) is tested and painted by the shell.

entries.name: InputTranscoder
entries.note: Purpose not determined: the extracted bundle has only an Info.plist that names the bundle, and the framework binary is not in the extract, so no counterpart can be named.

entries.name: Install
entries.note: The native installer lays down the system and the store installs packages from verified archives (store/install.rs). Gap: no installer-plugin or package-service API exists for third-party code, and package transactions go through pacman rather than a shared service.
entries.ready_note: The native installer lays down the system and the store installs verified packages; both paths are tested.

entries.name: InstallCoordination
entries.note: The update agent runs system installs and the shell's pacman module drives pacman, but no separate coordinating service exists and concurrent install arbitration has no test.
entries.ready_note: The update agent runs system installs and the shell's pacman_update module drives pacman, tested.

entries.name: InstallProgress
entries.note: The update agent pushes download progress to the shell about every second and the store reports app installs; system package install progress has no tested reporting path.
entries.ready_note: The store reports app install progress; system package install progress is still open in the note.

entries.name: InstalledContentLibrary
entries.note: Apple installed content catalogue (InstalledContentLibrary.plist); tied to Apple content services with no BifrOSt counterpart.

entries.name: InstallerDiagnostics
entries.note: springboard/updated writes each failed system update to install-failures.log in the shell data directory (install_log.rs, rotated at 256 KB, tested). Gap: app install failures are not logged yet, and the shell diagnostics page (springboard/src/shell/diagnostics_page.rs) does not list the log yet.

entries.name: IntelligenceEngine
entries.note: Apple Intelligence assistant engine (Info.plist only); Apple-hosted assistant service.

entries.name: IntelligenceFlow
entries.note: Apple Intelligence assistant flow resources (planner error strings, crisis resources, Apple domain disclaimers); Apple-hosted assistant.

entries.name: IntelligenceFlowAppIntentsPreviewToolSupport
entries.note: private framework, owner AppIntents; from SDK matrix app-intents.json The App Intents framework layer is ready (see the AppIntents row); this Apple app's own intents are not ported.

entries.name: IntelligenceFlowContext
entries.note: Apple Intelligence assistant context (Info.plist only).

entries.name: IntelligenceFlowContextRuntime
entries.note: Apple Intelligence context daemon (intelligencecontextd); Apple-hosted assistant.

entries.name: IntelligenceFlowConversationRuntime
entries.note: Apple Intelligence conversation runtime (Info.plist only).

entries.name: IntelligenceFlowErrorTypes
entries.note: Apple Intelligence assistant error types (Info.plist only).

entries.name: IntelligenceFlowPlannerRuntime
entries.note: Its assets_1760 risk.json and schemaRisk.json are the risk policies of the reference assistant planner, which runs on that vendor's assistant service.

entries.name: IntelligenceFlowPlannerSupport
entries.note: Holds the per-locale planner_tools.json and tool_retrieval_denylists.json catalogues of the reference assistant planner, which exist only for that vendor's assistant service.

entries.name: IntelligenceFlowProto
entries.note: Apple Intelligence assistant protobuf types (Info.plist only).

entries.name: IntelligenceFlowRuntime
entries.note: Ships the IntelligenceFlowDiagnostics and IntelligenceFlowCustomerDiagnostics extensions, which report to the reference vendor's diagnostics pipeline; there is no vendor pipeline to mirror.

entries.name: IntelligenceFlowShared
entries.note: Apple Intelligence assistant shared types (Info.plist only).

entries.name: IntelligencePlatform
entries.note: Ships a DiagnosticExtension and on-device name-linking and mention models (MDNameToEmailPersonLinker, MentionGenerationModel) for the reference vendor's personal knowledge store.

entries.name: IntelligencePlatformCompute
entries.note: Hosts the IntelligencePlatformComputeService XPC service that runs the reference vendor's on-device models on its own neural hardware, which BifrOSt does not mirror.

entries.name: IntelligencePlatformCore
entries.note: Holds the globalKnowledge subgraph assets of the reference vendor's knowledge graph (MediaEntitiesSubgraph.json, about 9 MB), built from that vendor's ecosystem data.

entries.name: IntelligencePlatformDataActions
entries.note: Apple Intelligence platform data actions (plist and strings); Apple-hosted assistant data layer.

entries.name: IntelligencePlatformLibrary
entries.note: Apple Intelligence platform library (Info.plist only).

entries.name: IntelligencePlatformQuery
entries.note: Apple Intelligence platform query (Info.plist only).

entries.name: IntelligenceSimulation
entries.note: Apple Intelligence simulation (Info.plist only); Apple-internal assistant testing.

entries.name: IntelligenceTasks
entries.note: Apple Intelligence tasks (Info.plist only); Apple-hosted assistant.

entries.name: IntelligenceTasksEngine
entries.note: Apple Intelligence tasks daemon (intelligencetasksd); Apple-hosted assistant.

entries.name: IntelligentRouting
entries.note: Routes the reference vendor's assistant requests between the device and that vendor's servers; its Resources carry intelligentRouting.momd, the Core Data model of that router.

entries.name: IntelligentRoutingDaemon
entries.note: The framework behind the reference vendor's intelligentroutingd service, which the daemons shard already classes n/a: it routes that vendor's assistant requests to its servers.

entries.name: IntelligentRoutingMediaBundles
entries.note: Media bundles that the reference vendor's assistant request router loads for its media answers; they depend on that vendor's assistant service and have no BifrOSt counterpart.

entries.name: IntelligentRoutingServices
entries.note: Service clients of the reference vendor's assistant request router, which call that vendor's servers; BifrOSt mirrors no such cloud service.

entries.name: IntentsCore
entries.note: private framework, owner Intents; from SDK matrix siri-kit.json

entries.name: IntentsFoundation
entries.note: private framework, owner Intents; from SDK matrix siri-kit.json

entries.name: IntentsServices
entries.note: private framework, owner Intents; from SDK matrix siri-kit.json

entries.name: IntentsUICardKitProviderSupport
entries.note: private framework, owner Intents; from SDK matrix siri-kit.json

entries.name: InternalSwiftProtobuf
entries.note: Vendored Swift protobuf runtime for Apple frameworks; BifrOSt has no Swift runtime.

entries.name: InternationalSupport
entries.note: Locale, number, date and list formatting with built-in en and is data. Other languages fall back to the en tables, so the reference language coverage is a gap.
entries.ready_note: Locale, number, date and list formatting with built-in en and is tables is tested; other languages fall back to en.

entries.name: InternationalTextSearch
entries.note: A word and prefix index over searchable items, with words taken as lowercase runs of letters. Script-specific word breaking and accent folding are not implemented.
entries.ready_note: Word and prefix index with lowercase-run tokenizing, tested.

entries.name: InternetAccounts
entries.note: CalDAV and CardDAV discovery, request bodies and multistatus reading. The account store and the sign-in interface are not covered by this module.

entries.name: IntlPreferences
entries.note: Locale identifiers and formatting for en and is. Other languages fall back to en, and no per-user region preference store is wired.

entries.name: IsolatedContextLogging
entries.note: App logging goes through the shared unified logging module, which the shell and apps both use. Per-isolated-context log streams of the reference are not modelled.

entries.name: IsolatedCoreAudioClient
entries.note: Process object and process tap models with their wire shapes, tested against a fake service. The audio daemon side is not implemented, so no isolated client reaches the device.
entries.ready_note: Process object and process tap models with wire shapes, tested against a fake service.

entries.name: iCalendar
entries.note: An RFC 5545 reader and writer for events covering line folding, RRULE, EXDATE, VALARM and VTIMEZONE offsets. The reference calendar database and sync are not covered.
entries.ready_note: The RFC 5545 reader and writer (folding, RRULE, EXDATE, VALARM, VTIMEZONE) is tested in the calendar app.

entries.name: iCloudDriveCore
entries.note: private framework, owner CloudKit; from SDK matrix cloudkit.json

entries.name: iCloudDriveService
entries.note: private framework, owner CloudKit; from SDK matrix cloudkit.json

entries.name: iCloudMailAssistant

entries.note: private framework, owner CloudKit; from SDK matrix cloudkit.json

entries.note: private framework, owner CloudKit; from SDK matrix cloudkit.json

entries.note: private framework, owner CloudKit; from SDK matrix cloudkit.json

entries.name: iCloudQuotaNetworking
entries.note: private framework, owner CloudKit; from SDK matrix cloudkit.json

entries.name: iCloudQuotaNetworkingCore
entries.note: private framework, owner CloudKit; from SDK matrix cloudkit.json

entries.name: iCloudQuotaUI
entries.note: private framework, owner CloudKit; from SDK matrix cloudkit.json

entries.name: iCloudSettings
entries.note: private framework, owner CloudKit; from SDK matrix cloudkit.json

entries.name: iCloudWebSupport
entries.note: private framework, owner CloudKit; from SDK matrix cloudkit.json

entries.name: iCloudWebUI
entries.note: private framework, owner CloudKit; from SDK matrix cloudkit.json

entries.name: iLifeMediaBrowser
entries.note: iLife media browser UI resources (clipboard drag images, transport art); belongs to Apple iLife apps, which BifrOSt does not ship.

entries.name: iPod
entries.note: Device sync for the reference iPod music player hardware. BifrOSt targets generic PC hardware and runs no iPod device support.

entries.name: iPodUpdater
entries.note: Firmware updater for iPod hardware (UpdaterBackEnd and PodBootHeader in the bundle). BifrOSt has no iPod devices to update.

entries.name: iPodVoiceOver
entries.note: Spoken artist-name pronunciation models for the iPod voice interface (identifier com.apple.PodSpeechLib). It serves only the iPod device UI, which BifrOSt does not have.

entries.name: iTunesCloud
entries.note: Shared listening XPC service for the reference music subscription cloud. A vendor cloud service that BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: iWorkXPC
entries.note: XPC file format service for the reference office suite's own document formats (iWorkFileFormat.xpc). BifrOSt ships no iWork apps, so the service has no caller here.

entries.name: icloudMCCKit
entries.note: private framework, owner CloudKit; from SDK matrix cloudkit.json
